final: WITH disease_counts AS (SELECT e.Diagnosis, COUNT(*) as dc FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.Diagnosis), total_sum AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(dc) AS FLOAT) as total FROM disease_counts), with_ratio AS (SELECT disease_counts.Diagnosis, disease_counts.dc, disease_counts.dc / total_sum.total as ratio FROM disease_counts, total_sum), avg_dc AS (SELECT AVG(dc) as avg_count FROM with_ratio) SELECT with_ratio.Diagnosis, with_ratio.dc, with_ratio.ratio, with_ratio.dc - avg_dc.avg_count FROM with_ratio, avg_dc WHERE with_ratio.dc > avg_dc.avg_count ORDER BY with_ratio.Diagnosis
